pinyin: nán dà dāng hūn, nǚ dà dāng jià
literal: man · grown · should · marry, woman · grown · should · marry out
natural: A grown man should marry, a grown woman should wed

meaning.en: When young people reach adulthood they should get married.
meaning.zh: 子女长大成人，就该成家。

examples.zh: 男大当婚，女大当嫁，妈妈总催我找对象。
examples.en: Adults should marry; my mum keeps pushing me to find a partner.

examples.zh: 男大当婚，女大当嫁，这是老一辈的观念。
examples.en: 'Adults should settle down' is the older generation's view.

usage.en: Traditional attitude, often cited by parents; many young people now find it old-fashioned. 当 is dāng, 'should'.
usage.zh: 传统观念，多为父母所说，现在不少年轻人不认同。

pinyin: yù bù zhuó, bù chéng qì
literal: jade · not · carved, not · become · vessel
natural: Uncarved jade does not become a vessel

meaning.en: Without education and training, even talented people can't realise their potential.
meaning.zh: 玉石不经雕琢就不能成为器物，人不经教育磨练就不能成才。

equivalents: Spare the rod and spoil the child

examples.zh: 玉不琢，不成器，再聪明的孩子也需要严格教育。
examples.en: Jade must be carved to become something; even a clever child needs a strict education.

examples.zh: 玉不琢，不成器，只有不断磨练才能成大器。
examples.en: Raw jade must be worked; only continuous training makes a great talent.

story.en: The Book of Rites says: 'If jade is not carved it does not become a vessel; if a person does not learn he does not know the Way.'
story.zh: 《礼记·学记》：“玉不琢，不成器；人不学，不知道。”

usage.en: Used in education contexts; continues 人不学，不知道.
usage.zh: 多用于教育场合，下句为“人不学，不知道”。

pinyin: fù cháo zhī xià, yān yǒu wán luǎn
literal: overturned · nest · 's · under · how · have · whole · egg
natural: Beneath an overturned nest, how can any egg be whole?

meaning.en: When the whole collapses, individual members cannot escape harm.
meaning.zh: 整体覆灭了，个体也无法幸免。

equivalents: When the ship sinks, all hands go down
If the house falls, no one is safe

examples.zh: 覆巢之下，焉有完卵，公司倒闭了，员工也难保饭碗。
examples.en: When the nest is overturned no egg survives; with the company gone, the staff's jobs are lost too.

examples.zh: 覆巢之下，焉有完卵，国家危亡时个人也难独善其身。
examples.en: When the nation is in peril, individuals can't stay safe alone.

story.en: When Kong Rong was arrested, his young children calmly kept playing, saying 'When the nest is overturned, are there any whole eggs?' They were executed with him.
story.zh: 孔融被捕时，其年幼的儿子神色不变，说：“大人岂见覆巢之下，复有完卵乎？”

usage.en: Serious, somewhat literary; used about crises affecting all. Variant 覆巢之下无完卵.
usage.zh: 语气沉重，略书面，多用于大难临头之时。

text: 天时不如地利，地利不如人和
pinyin: tiān shí bù rú dì lì, dì lì bù rú rén hé
literal: heaven's · timing · not · as good as · terrain, terrain · not · as good as · human · harmony
natural: Timing is not as good as terrain, terrain is not as good as unity

meaning.en: Favourable timing and geography matter less than the unity of the people.
meaning.zh: 天气时机不如地理形势，地理形势不如人心团结。

equivalents: United we stand, divided we fall

examples.zh: 天时不如地利，地利不如人和，团队团结才是成功的关键。
examples.en: Unity matters more than timing or terrain; team solidarity is the key to success.

examples.zh: 天时不如地利，地利不如人和，这场比赛靠的是全队的默契。
examples.en: Unity trumps timing and terrain; the team's understanding won this match.

story.en: Mencius argues that a besieged city may not fall to a good moment, nor to good terrain, but is decided by the people's unity.
story.zh: 《孟子·公孙丑下》：“天时不如地利，地利不如人和。”

usage.en: Often quoted in speeches about teamwork and in business.
usage.zh: 多见于讲话，强调团结的重要。

pinyin: xiān xiǎo rén, hòu jūn zǐ
literal: first · petty person, afterwards · gentleman
natural: First be petty, then be a gentleman

meaning.en: Settle terms strictly at the outset so friendships can stay cordial later.
meaning.zh: 事先把条件和责任讲清楚，以后才能和气相处。

examples.zh: 先小人，后君子，咱们还是把合同写清楚吧。
examples.en: Let's be businesslike first and gracious later; put the contract in writing.

examples.zh: 借钱先小人，后君子，打个借条比较好。
examples.en: When lending money, it's best to be strict first and write an IOU.

usage.en: Common in business and money matters; describes being strict first so that goodwill follows.
usage.zh: 常用于生意和借钱，先说清楚再谈情分。

pinyin: bú jiàn tù zi bù sā yīng
literal: not · see · rabbit · not · release · hawk
natural: Don't release the hawk until you see the rabbit

meaning.en: Don't commit before you see a clear benefit or sure thing.
meaning.zh: 没看到猎物不放鹰，比喻没有把握就不行动，不见好处不肯付出。

examples.zh: 他是不见兔子不撒鹰，没拿到定金绝不开工。
examples.en: He won't act until he sees a return and won't start without a deposit.

examples.zh: 投资人不见兔子不撒鹰，要看到样品才肯投钱。
examples.en: Investors won't commit until they see something concrete; they want to see a prototype.

usage.en: Describes cautious, self-interested dealing; can be mildly critical.
usage.zh: 形容谨慎或精明，有时略含贬义。

pinyin: dǎ tiě hái xū zì shēn yìng
literal: forge · iron · still · need · oneself · hard
natural: To forge iron you must yourself be strong

meaning.en: To accomplish anything demanding, you must be competent and strong yourself.
meaning.zh: 要做成事情，自己必须过硬。

equivalents: You need real skills to do the job

examples.zh: 打铁还需自身硬，要管别人，自己先得做出榜样。
examples.en: To forge iron you need to be strong yourself; to manage others, set an example first.

examples.zh: 打铁还需自身硬，想拿冠军就得先提高实力。
examples.en: You need to be strong yourself; to win the championship, improve your skills first.

usage.en: Popular in speeches and official discourse; 打铁先得自身硬 is a variant.
usage.zh: 常见于讲话和官方表述。

pinyin: rú rén yǐn shuǐ, lěng nuǎn zì zhī
literal: like · person · drink · water, cold · warm · oneself · know
natural: Like drinking water, you alone know whether it's cold or warm

meaning.en: Only you know how you really feel or what an experience is like.
meaning.zh: 如同喝水，冷暖只有自己知道，比喻只有亲身经历才有体会。

equivalents: Only the wearer knows where the shoe pinches

examples.zh: 婚姻好不好，如人饮水，冷暖自知。
examples.en: Whether a marriage is good, only the people in it can tell.

examples.zh: 别人怎么看不要紧，如人饮水，冷暖自知。
examples.en: It doesn't matter what others think; you alone know how it feels.

usage.en: Often used to say that outsiders can't judge someone's inner experience.
usage.zh: 常说明外人无法判断当事人的真实感受。

pinyin: jià jī suí jī, jià gǒu suí gǒu
literal: marry · chicken · follow · chicken, marry · dog · follow · dog
natural: Marry a chicken, follow the chicken; marry a dog, follow the dog

meaning.en: A wife should accept her husband's lot, whatever it is.
meaning.zh: 女子出嫁后无论丈夫境遇如何都要跟从。

equivalents: She made her bed and must lie in it

examples.zh: 奶奶那一辈信奉嫁鸡随鸡，嫁狗随狗，没怎么抱怨过。
examples.en: Grandma's generation believed a wife follows her husband for better or worse and seldom complained.

examples.zh: 现在没人再说嫁鸡随鸡，嫁狗随狗了。
examples.en: Nobody says 'marry a chicken, follow the chicken' any more.

usage.en: Reflects traditional gender roles; now often quoted critically or in historical context.
usage.zh: 反映传统观念，现多用于批评或描述旧时风俗。

pinyin: rén xīn qí, tài shān yí
literal: people · hearts · united, Mount Tai · move
natural: When hearts are united, Mount Tai can be moved

meaning.en: United people can accomplish even the hardest things.
meaning.zh: 大家团结一心，再难的事也能办成。

examples.zh: 人心齐，泰山移，大家一起动手，一周就修好了堤坝。
examples.en: With united hearts we can move mountains; working together we repaired the dam in a week.

examples.zh: 人心齐，泰山移，只要全村团结就能脱贫。
examples.en: United, we can move Mount Tai; if the village sticks together we can escape poverty.

usage.en: Slogan-like, used for motivation and teamwork. Often paired with 众人拾柴火焰高.
usage.zh: 口号式，用于激励团结，常与“众人拾柴火焰高”连用。

pinyin: yǔ rén fāng biàn, zì jǐ fāng biàn
literal: for · others · convenient, oneself · convenient
natural: Make things convenient for others and they will be convenient for you

meaning.en: Helping others makes your own life easier.
meaning.zh: 给别人方便，自己也会得到方便。

examples.zh: 与人方便，自己方便，把车往里停一点，让后面的人也能过。
examples.en: Do others a favour and you do yourself one; park a bit further in so the others can pass.

examples.zh: 与人方便，自己方便，大家互相体谅吧。
examples.en: What goes around comes around; let's be considerate of each other.

usage.en: Everyday ethical advice about being considerate; very common on public notices.
usage.zh: 日常道德劝导，在告示上常见。

pinyin: shàng yǒu tiān táng, xià yǒu sū háng
literal: above · have · heaven, below · have · Suzhou · Hangzhou
natural: Heaven above, Suzhou and Hangzhou below

meaning.en: Suzhou and Hangzhou are as lovely as paradise.
meaning.zh: 天上有天堂，地上有苏州和杭州，形容苏杭风景优美。

equivalents: Suzhou and Hangzhou are paradise on earth

examples.zh: 上有天堂，下有苏杭，来杭州不看西湖怎么行？
examples.en: Heaven above, Suzhou and Hangzhou below; you can't visit Hangzhou without seeing West Lake.

examples.zh: 上有天堂，下有苏杭，江南的风景名不虚传。
examples.en: The scenery of Jiangnan lives up to its name.

usage.en: Travel and tourism writing; praise of the two cities.
usage.zh: 多用于旅游宣传，赞美苏州、杭州。

pinyin: bǎi zú zhī chóng, sǐ ér bù jiāng
literal: hundred · legs · 's · insect, die · yet · not · stiffen
natural: A centipede dies but doesn't go stiff

meaning.en: A great, long-established house keeps some strength even after it declines.
meaning.zh: 大族或大势力即使衰败，仍有残余势力。

examples.zh: 这个家族虽然没落了，但百足之虫，死而不僵，影响力仍在。
examples.en: The clan has declined, but the centipede still twitches; its influence remains.

examples.zh: 百足之虫，死而不僵，别小看这家老企业。
examples.en: Don't underestimate the old firm; it is down but not out.

usage.en: Can be used with respect or warning; kin to 瘦死的骆驼比马大.
usage.zh: 可表示敬畏或提醒，与“瘦死的骆驼比马大”相近。

pinyin: jiǎn le zhī má, diū le xī guā
literal: pick up · sesame · lose · watermelon
natural: Picked up the sesame, lost the watermelon

meaning.en: To fuss over small gains and lose big ones.
meaning.zh: 因小失大，贪图小利而丢了大利。

equivalents: Spoil the ship for a ha'porth of tar

examples.zh: 为了省几块钱而误了航班，真是拣了芝麻，丢了西瓜。
examples.en: He saved a few yuan but missed his flight; he picked up the sesame and lost the watermelon.

examples.zh: 别拣了芝麻，丢了西瓜，大方向才是最重要的。
examples.en: Don't lose big gains for small ones; the main direction is what counts.

usage.en: Criticism of misplaced priorities. 捡 is the modern writing of 拣.
usage.zh: 批评因小失大。“捡”为“拣”的现代写法。

synonyms: 整筐丢西瓜，满地拾芝麻——大处不算小处算

text: 平时不烧香，临时抱佛脚
pinyin: píng shí bù shāo xiāng, lín shí bào fó jiǎo
literal: usually · not · burn · incense, at the last moment · hug · Buddha's · feet
natural: Never burning incense usually, then clutching the Buddha's feet at the last minute

meaning.en: To make no effort in advance, then scramble at the last minute.
meaning.zh: 平时不努力，事到临头才着急。

equivalents: Locking the stable door after the horse has bolted

examples.zh: 平时不烧香，临时抱佛脚，考试前一晚才开始复习。
examples.en: He never prepares, then clutches at straws; he only started revising the night before the exam.

examples.zh: 平时不烧香，临时抱佛脚，肯定来不及了。
examples.en: If you don't prepare in advance and panic later, it will surely be too late.

usage.en: Criticism of last-minute effort, especially before exams. 佛 here reads fó.
usage.zh: 批评临时才努力，多用于考试。

pinyin: yì kǒu chī bù chéng pàng zi
literal: one · mouthful · eat · cannot · become · fat man
natural: One mouthful can't make you fat

meaning.en: Big results take time; you can't do everything in one go.
meaning.zh: 一口饭吃不成胖子，比喻做事不能一下子成功，要逐步积累。

equivalents: Rome wasn't built in a day

examples.zh: 一口吃不成胖子，学语言要慢慢来。
examples.en: Rome wasn't built in a day; learning a language takes time.

examples.zh: 一口吃不成胖子，公司要一步一步做大。
examples.en: One bite won't make you fat; the company has to grow step by step.

usage.en: Advice to be patient; casual, often said to the impatient.
usage.zh: 劝人别急于求成，口语。

pinyin: yì shān bù róng èr hǔ
literal: one · mountain · not · hold · two · tigers
natural: One mountain can't hold two tigers

meaning.en: Two powerful rivals can't share the same territory.
meaning.zh: 两个强者不能共处一地，必有一争。

equivalents: There's not room for two kings in one kingdom
Two of a trade never agree

examples.zh: 一山不容二虎，公司里两个总监迟早要争权。
examples.en: One mountain can't hold two tigers; the two directors will eventually fight for power.

examples.zh: 一山不容二虎，这两位明星关系一直不好。
examples.en: Two tigers can't share a mountain; the two stars have never got on.

usage.en: About rivalry between strong people; the continuation 除非一公一母 is a joke about partners.
usage.zh: 多指强者间的竞争，常带调侃：“除非一公一母”。

synonyms: 一个槽里拴不下两头叫驴

pinyin: zuò yì tiān hé shang zhuàng yì tiān zhōng
literal: be · one · day · monk · strike · one · day · bell
natural: As long as you're a monk for a day, strike the bell for a day

meaning.en: To do the bare minimum of one's job without initiative.
meaning.zh: 得过且过，只做分内的事，不求上进。

examples.zh: 他做一天和尚撞一天钟，对工作毫无热情。
examples.en: He just goes through the motions without any enthusiasm for the job.

examples.zh: 别抱着做一天和尚撞一天钟的态度，要想想将来。
examples.en: Don't just drift along; think about the future.

usage.en: Criticism of apathy; 和尚 is read hé shang. Frequently self-mocking.
usage.zh: 批评消极怠工，常自嘲。

pinyin: yǒu qí fù bì yǒu qí zǐ
literal: have · such · father · must · have · such · son
natural: Such a father must have such a son

meaning.en: Children resemble their parents in temperament and behaviour.
meaning.zh: 儿子的性格作风多像父亲。

equivalents: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree

examples.zh: 他爸爸爱喝酒，他也爱喝酒，有其父必有其子。
examples.en: His father likes a drink and so does he; like father, like son.

examples.zh: 有其父必有其子，爷俩都是急脾气。
examples.en: Like father like son, both of them are hot-tempered.

usage.en: Can be praise or criticism depending on context.
usage.zh: 视语境可褒可贬。

synonyms: 龙配龙，凤配凤，老鼠的孩子会打洞
龙生龙，凤生凤，老鼠的儿子会打洞

pinyin: sān jù huà bù lí běn háng
literal: three · sentences · not · leave · own · trade
natural: Not three sentences without returning to your trade

meaning.en: To keep talking about one's own profession.
meaning.zh: 说不了几句话就扯到自己的职业上。

examples.zh: 他是厨师，三句话不离本行，聊天也说菜谱。
examples.en: He's a chef and can't help talking shop; even in chat he talks about recipes.

examples.zh: 医生三句话不离本行，吃饭都要讲养生。
examples.en: Doctors can't stop talking about their field; even at dinner it is all health tips.

usage.en: Usually a light-hearted observation; 行 here is háng.
usage.zh: 多为善意调侃，“行”读háng。

pinyin: chī ruǎn bù chī yìng
literal: eat · soft · not · eat · hard
natural: Takes the soft but not the hard

meaning.en: Responds to gentle persuasion but resists pressure.
meaning.zh: 接受温和劝说，不接受强硬压迫。

equivalents: You catch more flies with honey than with vinegar

examples.zh: 他这个人吃软不吃硬，你好好说他就听。
examples.en: He responds to kindness but not to force; speak nicely and he'll listen.

examples.zh: 孩子吃软不吃硬，别吼他。
examples.en: The child responds to gentleness, not pressure, so don't shout at him.

usage.en: Describes personality; often followed by advice to be gentle.
usage.zh: 形容性格，常接劝人温和相待。

pinyin: bú kàn sēng miàn kàn fó miàn
literal: not · look · monk's · face · look · Buddha's · face
natural: If not for the monk's face, look at the Buddha's face

meaning.en: Forgive or help someone for the sake of a third person you respect.
meaning.zh: 若不看这个人的情面，也要看他背后的人的情面。

equivalents: For the sake of the one who sent him
Do it as a favour to me

examples.zh: 不看僧面看佛面，看在你爸爸的份上我原谅他。
examples.en: If not for his sake, then for the sake of the one behind him; I forgive him for your father's sake.

examples.zh: 不看僧面看佛面，您就帮帮他吧。
examples.en: If you won't do it for him, do it for the person who sent him; please help.

usage.en: A way of asking a favour via a respected third party.
usage.zh: 借第三人情面求情或请求帮忙。

pinyin: zhè shān wàng zhe nà shān gāo
literal: this · mountain · look · that · mountain · high
natural: On this mountain, the other looks higher

meaning.en: Never content with what you have, always thinking elsewhere is better.
meaning.zh: 总觉得别处比自己这里好，不满足现状。

equivalents: The grass is always greener on the other side

examples.zh: 他换了好几份工作，总是这山望着那山高。
examples.en: He has changed jobs several times; the grass is always greener elsewhere.

examples.zh: 别这山望着那山高，踏实把眼前的工作做好。
examples.en: Don't think the grass is greener elsewhere; do the job in front of you well.

usage.en: Criticism of restlessness; 着 neutral here.
usage.zh: 批评不安分、不知足。

synonyms: 孩子是自己的好，老婆是别人的好

pinyin: gōng dào zì rán chéng
literal: effort · reach · naturally · succeed
natural: With enough effort, success will come

meaning.en: If you put in enough effort, success will follow naturally.
meaning.zh: 下足了功夫，成功自然水到渠成。

examples.zh: 功到自然成，只要坚持练习，一定能学会。
examples.en: Success follows effort; keep practising and you'll certainly learn it.

examples.zh: 别着急，功到自然成。
examples.en: Don't rush; with enough effort success will come.

usage.en: Encouragement, often with 皇天不负有心人.
usage.zh: 多用于鼓励，常与“皇天不负有心人”连用。

synonyms: 天下无难事，只怕有心人
台上一分钟，台下十年功
